_about: Bundled onboarding copy for the curiosity page (User.goal_anchor). The page appears only when CURIOSITY_ONBOARDING is on AND the question and every label exist for the current language; a missing bridge is skipped. Never generated by the lesson factory.

explorer.en: Muhammad ﷺ claimed to bring a message from the Creator. To examine that claim fairly, we will first explore whether there is a Creator and whether revelation makes sense. Then we will return to Muhammad ﷺ.
